title: Xian Ni Movie: Shi Xian Zhi Zhan

synopsis:
Pursued relentlessly by his sworn enemy in the Thunder Celestial Realm, Wang Lin is pushed to the absolute brink of death. Trapped with no escape, he launches an earth-shattering counterattack, defying impossible odds as the underdog to accomplish a legendary feat—slaying a celestial.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
